application_review: PROGRESS. Previous round baseline proof hashes are preserved.
Direction reflection is an explicit involutive equivalence, valid in every additive commutative group.
The vertex identity is proved coordinatewise, including overlapping and empty vertex sets, using symmetric difference.
Joint mean invariance follows from root translation, Fubini, and the direction equivalence. No probabilistic independence assumption is added.
The mixed product result allows distinct functions at all vertices and proves the exact change of variables without division or nonvanishing assumptions.
One definition and three theorems are individually audited. Higher-order concatenation, Bessel and inverse existence remain unproved.
remaining: The common-system master estimates, first-order Bessel, dual energy reduction, recursion and stability are proved. Exact arbitrary-vertex reflection of the actual subgroup cube law and mixed products is now proved. Higher-order concatenation controlling dual correlations and the full qualitative Bessel theorem remain missing, as do remaining replica integration, cyclic-to-interval transfer and inverse correlator existence. Coloring-derived targets, Calibration/Alignment and final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction remain. StrongConjecture is unchanged and unproved. No unavoidable blocker is established; publication, PR and prize application remain pending.
